channel.title: NRIin — Investing in India from abroad
channel.description: Daily rule changes, news and guides for NRIs and OCI cardholders investing in Indian stocks and mutual funds.

item.title: Repatriating money from India: NRO limits, Form 15CA and 15CB
item.description: How much you can send abroad from NRE and NRO accounts, the USD 1 million rule, and when you need a CA certificate before your bank will remit.

item.title: FATCA and CRS declarations for NRIs, explained
item.description: Why every Indian bank, broker and fund house asks for a FATCA/CRS self-certification, what to declare, and what happens to the information.

item.title: Moved abroad? Converting your Indian accounts and investments to NRI status
item.description: The checklist for bank accounts, demat, mutual fund folios, SIPs, KYC and tax records when you become a non-resident.

item.title: NRE vs NRO vs FCNR: which account to use for investing in India
item.description: How the three non-resident accounts differ on funding, tax and repatriation, and which one to link to your demat and mutual fund folios.

item.title: NRI KYC status explained: Registered, Validated, On Hold (2026)
item.description: What each KRA status means for NRIs and OCIs, why folios get frozen, and the exact steps to reach KYC Validated in 2026.

item.title: OCI cardholders and Indian investments: what you can and cannot do
item.description: OCI cardholders invest in Indian stocks and mutual funds on the same footing as NRIs. The exceptions, the extra documents and how tax residency works.

item.title: SEBI digital KYC from abroad for NRIs and OCIs (effective 3 Dec 2026)
item.description: SEBI's November 2026 circular removes the India-presence requirement for digital KYC. Who qualifies, what documents work, and how video verification will run.

item.title: GIFT City for NRIs: USD funds, deposits and portfolio management
item.description: What India's International Financial Services Centre offers non-residents, minimum amounts, tax treatment, and why US persons still need to think about PFIC.

item.title: Indian mutual funds for US and Canada NRIs: who still accepts you (2026)
item.description: Why most Indian fund houses refuse US and Canada residents, which ones are reported to accept them, and how to invest without breaking their rules.

item.title: How to open an NRI demat and trading account: step by step
item.description: Bank-linked 3-in-1 or discount broker, repatriable or non-repatriable, the documents you need and how long it takes in 2026.

item.title: IPOs, F&O and intraday trading: what NRIs are allowed to do
item.description: How NRIs apply for IPOs, the custodial participant route for futures and options, and why intraday and short selling stay off limits.

item.title: Portfolio Investment Scheme (PIS) after the June 2026 FEMA changes
item.description: The June 2026 FEMA amendment opened listed Indian shares to all overseas individuals and raised limits to 10% and 24%. What changed for NRIs and OCIs.

item.title: Claiming treaty (DTAA) relief as an NRI: TRC, Form 10F and lower TDS
item.description: How to use India's tax treaty with your country to cut withholding on dividends and interest, what documents to file and when, and how lower-deduction certificates work.

item.title: Moving back to India: RNOR status and what happens to your investments
item.description: How the Resident but Not Ordinarily Resident window works, what to do with NRE, FCNR and foreign accounts, and the tax traps for returning US persons.

item.title: PFIC and Indian mutual funds: what US persons must know
item.description: Why Indian mutual funds, ETFs and ULIPs are usually PFICs for US taxpayers, what Form 8621 costs, and the structures US persons commonly use instead.

item.title: TDS and capital gains tax for NRIs under the Income-tax Act, 2025
item.description: Rates, holding periods and withholding on Indian shares and mutual funds for non-residents from tax year 2026-27, and how to reclaim excess TDS.
